settings.heading: The whole household, on one wall.
settings.text: A touchscreen calendar for your home. It syncs the calendars you already use and shows everyone's week at a glance.

settings.heading: Syncs with your calendars
settings.text: Connect Google, iCloud and Outlook calendars once. New events show up on the wall on their own.

settings.heading: A colour for everyone
settings.text: Each person gets their own colour, so anyone can see who needs to be where from across the room.

settings.heading: Chore charts kids tap off
settings.text: Set up routines and chores. Kids tick them off on the screen and see their own progress.

settings.heading: Meal plan for the week
settings.text: Plan dinners next to the schedule, so the question of what's for tea is already answered.

settings.heading: Shared lists
settings.text: Groceries, packing and to-dos live on the display and on every family member's phone.

settings.heading: A photo frame when idle
settings.text: When nobody is using it, the screen turns into a slideshow of your family photos.

settings.heading: One screen for everything the house runs on
Hang it or stand it
settings.text: Use the included wall mount or the stand. All it needs is a power socket and Wi-Fi.

settings.heading: Connect your calendars
settings.text: Sign in from your phone and pick which calendars to show. Give each person a colour.

settings.heading: Everyone stays in sync
settings.text: Add an event on any phone and it appears on the wall. Change it on the wall and it updates everywhere.

settings.answer: Say plainly whether every feature is included in the price or whether some need a subscription.

settings.question: How does it mount, and does it need to be plugged in?
settings.answer: Explain what's in the box for mounting, the cable length, and that it needs mains power and Wi-Fi.

settings.question: What happens to our calendar data?
settings.answer: Describe where calendar data is stored and who can see it, and link to your privacy policy.
